reviewed_by: Codex review of nebula-v3.0.11 failure artifacts and PR #778 current main
reason: The release matrix failed in Work import desktop/compact, two 320 px project picker journeys, two 320 px phone navigation journeys, and a 430 px WebKit conversation switching case. Work import now gates on completed pairing and visible durable state instead of obsolete ready-chip, chat-tab, and parent-link assumptions. Phone project switching starts in Workbench More. At 320 px the shell deliberately hides its sidebar toggle and keeps a Workbench return above resource inspectors; wider phones retain the drawer. The 430 px conversation test waits for preview preparation before simulating rich-content growth and atomically reveals a transient image preview before asserting the selected session's text. Exact WebKit and Chromium cases test saved state, scroll-follow, and recovery. Catalogued cases cover those routes, desktop/compact behavior, and the production real-Core LAN boundary.
exclusions: The branch diff from current main changes only browser tests and their exact impact catalog entries. PR #778 notebook code is already in the baseline and its selected checks passed separately. Backend, frontend unit, native, unrelated browser journeys, and the full suite are excluded. Work import uses a production UI bundle and real Core on a non-loopback LAN origin; interface journeys use the browser fixture.
